ga4.note: GA4 was installed after the current settled reporting window. Zero settled sessions are expected and must not be treated as a tracking failure.

definitions.d1: First-party browser-confirmed ToolScout activity. Primary operational truth for likely-human sessions and outbound monetization.

definitions.gsc: Google Search source of truth for clicks, impressions, CTR and average position.
